name: mcp-free-cachyos
description: Hardened ChatGPT-native computer control with evidence-bound persistent development workers for CachyOS.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate bounded, evidence-bound work on CachyOS
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT remains the sole reasoning model. A private MCP coordinator runs up to three deterministic inspection workers, binds terminal outputs to hash-chained receipts, protects physical path boundaries and active worktrees, applies bounded patches, and verifies complete Git/worktree bytes.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my CachyOS computer in observe mode and report its state without changing anything.
Act as the only development model. Dispatch explore, design, and review workers, then process each evidence-bound result while the others continue.
Recover or cancel persistent orchestration state as needed, preserve existing work, verify exact bytes, and include all receipts.
